Initial release: AI-powered video editing and export with cloud processing

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and generate polished edits with cloud-based AI.
- Automatic session and token management with up to 100 free credits.
- Fast export of 1080p MP4 files; typical processing takes 1–2 minutes.
- Interactive workflows: trim footage, add transitions, export, check credits/balance, preview timelines, and more.
- Handles common video editing tasks via chat commands; supports quick edits and iterative refinement.
- Detailed error handling and session management included for a smooth user experience.
